info.title: Airline Management API
info.description: API contracts migrated from the VB.NET AirlineManagement WinForms application to .NET 9 / React. This endpoint replaces the grid load performed by MasterBookingsForm.LoadBookings, returning every booking with its flight and passenger details in the same display format used by the legacy grid.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Operations for managing and listing airline bookings

get.summary: List all bookings for the master bookings grid
get.description: Returns every booking ordered by booking date descending (newest first). Each item is one grid row produced by the legacy MasterBookingsForm.LoadBookings method. For each booking, the associated flight is loaded by flight_id and the associated user is loaded by user_id when present. When the booking has no user, the User field is 'Guest'. Dates and times are formatted as in the legacy grid: departureDate as yyyy-MM-dd, departureTime and arrivalTime as hh:mm, and bookingDate as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The seatNumber field is 'N/A' when the booking has no seat assigned. The route is 'Origin → Destination'. The price is the flight price, which the legacy grid displayed with currency format 'C'; the API returns the raw numeric value and the client applies currency formatting.

200.description: Bookings retrieved successfully. Returns an empty array when no bookings exist.

401.description: Unauthorized. The caller is not authenticated. The legacy form has no authentication check; this response is reserved for the target API's authentication layer.

example.message: Authentication is required to access this resource.

403.description: Forbidden. The caller is authenticated but not permitted to view all bookings. The legacy form has no role check; this response is reserved for the target API's authorization layer.

example.message: You do not have permission to view all bookings.

500.description: Internal server error. Raised when a database error occurs or when a booking references a flight that does not exist (the legacy code dereferences the flight object without a null check).

example.message: An unexpected error occurred while loading bookings.

BookingGridRow.description: One booking row as displayed in the master bookings grid.

id.description: Booking identifier prefixed with '#', e.g. '#1'. Corresponds to the legacy grid column 'Booking ID'.

user.description: Username and full name in the form 'username (FullName)', or 'Guest' when the booking has no user.

flightNumber.description: Flight number of the booked flight.

route.description: Flight route in the form 'Origin → Destination'.

departureDate.description: Flight departure date, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

departureTime.description: Flight departure time, formatted as hh:mm.

arrivalTime.description: Flight arrival time, formatted as hh:mm.

passengerName.description: Name of the passenger on the booking.

passengerEmail.description: Email address of the passenger on the booking.

seatNumber.description: Assigned seat number, or 'N/A' when no seat is assigned.

price.description: Flight price as a decimal number. The legacy grid displayed this value with currency formatting.

bookingDate.description: Booking creation date and time, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

message.example: An unexpected error occurred while loading bookings.
